title: Alt text not returned in media upload API response
description: When uploading media with description (alt text), the value is stored correctly in the DB but the API response returns description: null. The media_attachments array in status responses may also be missing the description. Need to verify: (1) upload response includes description, (2) status response includes description in media_attachments, (3) AP Note attachment[].name carries the alt text for federation.
